fusions.name: Sleight Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses a pocketed pebble that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to confuse it for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Baited Leavings
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles for 30 seconds. Each bursts the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it and deals 26 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Under the Leaf Pile
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10%. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Skimmed Off the Top
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 6 mana. Once every 5 seconds.
